title: Stock Photos
description: Search Pixabay from the object editor. Photos you drop on a field are downloaded and stored with the photographer's credit.

pixabayKey.label: Pixabay API Key
pixabayKey.help: Sign up at pixabay.com, then copy your key from pixabay.com/api/docs. The key stays on the server; the browser never sees it. Photos are used under the Pixabay Content License.

safeSearch.label: Safe Search
safeSearch.help: Only show photos suitable for all ages.

defaultOrientation.label: Default Orientation
defaultOrientation.help: The orientation filter the search panel starts with.
